title: Real same-budget paired direct vs adaptive-strategy run on TraeX (observed-call-count)

realExternalSystem.measurementIntegrity: One settled model request counts as one modelCall. Aggregate inputTokens/outputTokens are always 0, usage and costUsdMicros are always null; tokens/money are never estimated or fabricated. A provider usage chunk would reject the stream rather than be silently dropped. promotionAuthorized is always false. This is a real provider run, not a fixture/dry-run/local HTTP double.

timeBudget.invariant: verification.maxDurationMs * cases.length < stepMaxDurationMs and stepMaxDurationMs * 3 < budget.durationMs (120000*3=360000 < 450000)

priorRun.outcome: 6 achieved then fail-fast at cell 7 (dependency-topological-order adaptive-strategy repeat 0): 'incomplete benchmark meter measurement'

retainedTrace.interpretation: Trace #1 started at 1789469169385; the 7th in-flight request started 62.1s later, past the 60s admission wall. options.signal aborted the read while the request was already dispatched to the real server. The meter correctly fail-closed retained it (heldModelCalls=1) and assertComplete correctly refused. An abort only proves the client stopped reading; it cannot prove the server did not execute or bill, so a dispatched request is never counted settled. No product-code defect: the 60s wall was miscalibrated for real TraeX latency (~10s per round trip).

calibratedRun.result: 16/16 cleanly completed, zero retained, zero rejected

pairedComparison.extraCallsInterpretation: Differences swing both ways within [-4,+2] with no systematic positive cost. They are single-parent model-call noise, not coordination overhead: a real advisory-persona spawn would add a stable block of child calls per consultation, but every cell had exactly one '-g1' parent session and zero child sessions. The report (byte-identical to the run result) carries these same figures.

whatThisRunProves: The corpus->doctor->plan->run->report pipeline is end-to-end reliable against REAL TraeX gpt-5.6-terra under a realistic time budget: 16/16 cells achieved, zero retained, zero rejected, zero fabricated token/cost fields, promotionAuthorized=false.

The earlier 60s failure was a pure time-budget miscalibration for real ~10s/call TraeX latency, not a product defect; the meter fail-closed and assertComplete behaved correctly. 120s/450s is a sufficient fix (slowest real span 79.1s, 40.9s headroom).
whatThisRunDoesNotProve: It does NOT demonstrate any adaptive-strategy benefit. Both arms achieved all four development tasks (8 ties, delta 0, bootstrap CI [0,0]): a ceiling effect, the tasks are too easy for gpt-5.6-terra.

The RSI core mechanism (concurrent skeptical/alternative advice-only persona children) was NEVER exercised: 0/16 cells spawned a strategy, 0/16 had a non-parent model session, children modelCalls sum to 0. The adaptive arm degenerated to 'the same parent agent taking a different number of rounds', so the arm contrast did not measure the target mechanism.
No token or monetary cost comparison is possible in call-count mode by design; those fields are null, not zero-benefit evidence.

observedMechanismGap.summary: Across all 16 adaptive-strategy cells native.strategies=[] and every meter trace sessionId ends in '-g1' (the single parent). Goal runs were 1 (or 2 on a few cells), i.e. the model passed the independent verifier on the first round.
observedMechanismGap.rootCauseVerdict: MODEL-AUTONOMOUS NON-INVOCATION UNDER A CEILING CORPUS, NOT A WIRING/PREAUTH DEFECT. goal_strategy is a purely model-discretionary tool (there is no code path that auto-spawns a persona). The tool was genuinely delivered to the model on every adaptive request and every authorisation gate passes, yet the model chose not to call it because the corpus never reached the trigger condition described in the tool itself ('uncertain reasoning or repeated failed criteria').
codeGatesVerified: Registered only when service.strategyEnabled (plugins/assistant-goals/src/tools.ts:21-33); strategyEnabled = strategy!==undefined (service.ts:273); the benchmark installs the strategy config solely on the adaptive arm (strategy-goal-runtime.ts:149 enabled=variant.id==='adaptive-strategy', :154 adds goal_strategy to toolNames, :250 passes strategy config) — the direct arm never mounts it.

preauthorizeStrategy requires budget.hasMeter(agent.options)===true (service.ts:1001-1008). In calls mode hasMeter returns this.#active && this.#routeAllowed(route) with NO meter-map lookup (budget.ts:253-254); #routeAllowed exact-matches {provider,model} against the calls whitelist (budget.ts:303) which is {traex-agent,gpt-5.6-terra}; #active stays true for the whole run and flips false only on runtime teardown (budget.ts:94,144). So the preauth gate passes.

runStrategy additionally requires an active native goal round (service.ts:1009-1016). That round was active: the same model calls in the same cells successfully invoked goal_create/isolation_run/goal_context/goal_checkpoint, which cross the same round gate.
observedMechanismGap.transcriptEvidence: Inspected the 16 real owner session.jsonl transcripts under cal-state/. Exactly the 8 adaptive-arm sessions contain goal_strategy; the 8 direct-arm sessions never do. In each of the 8 adaptive sessions the tool literally appears in request/header.header.tools on every model request (e.g. cell-qMwZxV session lines 8,26,50 show {"name":"goal_strategy",...}) AND the goal-round system text advertises it — yet the tool/call sequence across all 8 is only goal_create -> isolation_run [-> goal_context|goal_checkpoint], with goal_strategy ACTUAL CALLS = 0/8. Offered-but-uncalled, on every turn.
observedMechanismGap.triggerSemantics: The tool description invites consultation 'on uncertain reasoning or repeated failed criteria'. All four strategy-v1 tasks were solved by isolation_run and accepted by the independent verifier on round 1 (a handful on round 2); there was never a failed criterion or genuine uncertainty to motivate a consultation. This is a corpus-difficulty/trigger-semantics ceiling, not a gating bug.

nextSteps: RESOLVED 2026-09-15: why persona children never trigger is now pinned — model-autonomous non-invocation under a ceiling corpus, not a wiring/preauth defect (see findings.observedMechanismGap.rootCauseVerdict with file:line gates and the 8-transcript offered-but-0-called audit). No code change is warranted for the trigger path.

Use a harder corpus (and/or induce a first-round verifier failure) so the goal reaches the state that drives persona consultation; otherwise the paired contrast cannot measure the intended mechanism. Concretely: add strategy-v1 tasks that isolation_run cannot solve on round 1 (multi-constraint / adversarial verifier), or inject a seeded first-round rejection, then re-run the same call-count paired harness and confirm native.strategies>0 and a stable block of non-g1 child calls before judging any benefit.

Optionally strengthen the tool description / round nudge to make consultation opt-in earlier, but only AFTER a harder corpus shows whether the current failure-gated semantics is itself the limiter; do not tune the prompt to manufacture a benefit.
